title: DashboardQueryResponse
description: Result for method data.query.dashboard. amount / margin / turnover values are in 亿元.

breadth.description: Latest-day counts plus limit-up/limit-down history. series items are { trade_date, limit_up_count, limit_down_count }. universe echoes breadth_universe (default all). constituent_as_of is latest index_weight snapshot when filtered by index.

basis.description: Four index-futures products in IH/IF/IC/IM order. Each item is { product, fut_code, spot_code, name, series[{ trade_date, fut_close, spot_close, basis }] }. basis = spot_close - fut_close. Empty series when futures are missing.
